title: Automated Video-to-QA Pipeline: End-to-End Question Generation and Verification Using Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.07755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The exponential growth of educational and informational video content on platforms like YouTube presents a challenge for efficient knowledge retrieval and assessment. This paper proposes an end-to-end automated pipeline for extracting structured summaries and generating high-fidelity Question-Answer (QA) pairs from video streams. The framework integrates a cascade of state-of-the-art models: audio extraction is handled via FFmpeg, followed by automatic speech recognition (ASR) using Whisper (A library in Python) to generate accurate transcripts. Due to the token constraints of Large Language Models (LLMs), transcripts are segmented and summarized using Facebook's BART. A key innovation of this work is a Self-Verification and Fine-Tuning Loop. translated_title: 自动化视频转问答流水线：基于大型语言模型的端到端问题生成与验证
translated_abstract: YouTube等平台上教育和信息类视频内容的爆炸式增长，为高效的知识检索与评估带来了挑战。本文提出了一种端到端的自动化流水线，用于从视频流中提取结构化摘要并生成高保真度的问答对。该框架集成了多个最先进模型的级联：音频提取通过FFmpeg处理，随后使用Whisper（一个Python库）进行自动语音识别（ASR）以生成准确的转录文本。由于大型语言模型（LLM）的token限制，转录文本被分段并使用Facebook的BART进行摘要。本工作的一项关键创新是自我验证与微调循环。我们利用meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct从转录文本片段中生成候选问答对，然后将其反馈给模型，以严格评估其相关性和重要性。仅经验证的问答对……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种端到端自动化流水线，通过级联整合FFmpeg、Whisper、BART和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct等模型，从视频中提取结构化摘要并生成问答对，其核心创新在于引入自我验证与微调循环，让模型自我评估并保留高质量问答对。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an end-to-end automated pipeline that cascades FFmpeg, Whisper, BART, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct to extract structured summaries and generate high-fidelity QA pairs from videos, with a novel Self-Verification and Fine-Tuning Loop that lets the model assess candidate QA pairs and retain only high-quality ones.
